summary: RMX Industries filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026 reporting an email agreement dated September 28, 2026 with an institutional investor to extend the maturity of its Initial Note. The Initial Note, original principal $2,020,000, was issued November 5, 2025 under a $50,000,000 senior secured convertible note facility bearing 15% interest, convertible into class A common stock. Maturity moves to December 31, 2026, auto-extending to March 31, 2027 if the common stock uplists to an eligible national exchange before December 31, 2026. This is an ordinary debt-amendment credit event, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, or board recommendation stated.
